I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. It has no lodash import and uses `merge`, `startCase` and `zipObject` from `es-toolkit`. The lodash version of `src/module.ts` could not be run here, so I couldn't compare results against the original or measure its size.

- **Signatures:** `Row`, `Config`, `applyPatch`, `toTitle` and `toLookup` keep their original signatures.
- **`applyPatch`:** `es-toolkit`'s `merge` mutates `base` and merges arrays index by index, as lodash's `merge` does. In my check, base `{a:[1,2,3]}` patched with `{a:[9]}` gave `[9,2,3]`, and `null` values were kept.
- **`toTitle`:** `startCase` gave `"Size User Usersize"` for `"Size UserUsersize."` and `"A 1 B C D E"` for `"a1b-C_D.e"`. I didn't check these against lodash's output.
- **`toLookup`:** the main `es-toolkit` entry has no `fromPairs`. I used `zipObject(pairs.map(p => p[0]), pairs.map(p => p[1]))`, which is the small adapter. Duplicate names resolve to the last value, as in lodash, and an empty input returns `{}`.
- **Bundle size:** `npm run size -- out/module.ts` prints 553 bytes (min+gzip) with 110 bytes of own code. I also tried `fromPairs` from `es-toolkit/compat`. That gave 607 bytes with 82 bytes of own code, so I kept the `zipObject` version because it is smaller overall.
- **Own-code bytes:** 110 bytes may or may not be within the allowance, because I couldn't measure the original's own-code size.
- **Type check:** the only `npx tsc -p .` errors were in `src/module.ts`, which can't find the `lodash/*` modules because lodash isn't installed. None were reported for `out/module.ts`. The run printed only those errors, so I didn't see a clean pass for the whole project.
